Of these, 11 were in Africa, 14 in Asia, and 1 in Europe (Table 1, Fig. 1). No new territory was affected during the year. Regional picture 1976 (GHO cholera series): Malawi 19, Mozambique 3, Southern Rhodesia 144, Angola and Tanzania none - low activity on the borders.
